name: chojema-dooroo
description: Chojema Dooroo — HWP and HWPX desktop word processor

scripts.build: npm run build -w @genoffice/hwp && npm run build -w @chojema/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @chojema/desktop && npm run typecheck -w @genoffice/hwp
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run notices && npm run dist:win -w @chojema/desktop -- --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npm run notices && npm run dist:mac -w @chojema/desktop -- --publish never
